summary: John's 2nd great-uncle; brother of William F. Meier.
bio:
Born 24 Aug 1894 in Hazleton; saddler apprentice in a harness shop at 15 (1910); in Jan 1920, as 'Harry J. Jr.', 25, iron-works laborer, he lived at 296 Barney St next door to his parents with wife Mary and son Robert.

The 1957 Pennsylvania death index lists 'MEIER HARRY J, 62, WLKS BRE, county 40, died 01/29/57, file 5614' ([R4-S1]). This confirms the FamilySearch date of 29 Jan 1957. The tree had only the year. FamilySearch also gives burial at St Mary's Cemetery, Hanover Twp, on 1 Feb 1957 ([R4-S3]). His marriage docket (No. 79542, June 1917) shows him as a 22-year-old moulder like his father. He married Mary M. Proudlove of Forty Fort, whose father was an English-born blacksmith ([R4-S2]). On this docket his father's birthplace is written 'Penna', which contradicts the German birth recorded elsewhere. Their children were Robert J. (1918–98), Marjorie (1920–2010, Mrs. Harold Stitzer), Harry J. Jr. (1924–95) and Regina (1926–2012, Mrs. Francis Gimber) ([R4-S3]).
